title: Uniform estimate of Lang-Weil type for counting points of schemes over finite rings
summary: In this paper, we study the number of points of $\mathbb{Z}$-schemes $X$ of finite type over the finite rings $\mathbb{Z}/p^m\mathbb{Z}$ for positive integers $m$ and prime numbers $p$. Motivated by Igusa's conjecture for exponential sums and the Lang-Weil estimate, we establish an estimate of $X(\mathbb{Z}/p^m\mathbb{Z})$ in terms of $m$, $X(\mathbb{Z}/p^{m-1}\mathbb{Z})$ and poles of the $p$-adic Igusa local zeta function of $X$ uniformly in $m\geq 2$ and $p$. Our estimate might be viewed as an inductive version for counting points of schemes over finite rings of the Lang-Weil estimate.…
